decisions.title: Factory copy is default

goals.title: General-purpose bounded Factory delegation
goals.why: Remove the need for Chief to build a new deterministic worker for each new task class while preserving bounded authority, receipts, tests, and no-production-default behavior.

history.text: Cybertron gained a physical basement rack. Four ThinkCentre M73s are present; three for compute and one reserved as human console. Fifth Lenovo remains upstairs with Autumn. UniFi AP AC Pro also available. Build has not started.

Shannon correctly observed that Chief was doing too much around the Sentinel Factory build. Current Factory executes specialized deterministic workers but is not yet a general-purpose delegated builder. Default future behavior: send Factory a copy/work order unless Chief-only is genuinely required.
